---
title: "Hadley W Workspace"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(tidycensus)
```

```{r}
df = st_read("../data/raw/shp_trans_transit_count_headway_sum/")
```

```{r}
tracts <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = "B19013_001", 
  state = "MN",
  year = 2022,
  geometry = TRUE 
)
```

```{r}
st_crs(tracts)
st_crs(df)

lines <- st_transform(df, st_crs(tracts))


```

```{r}
lines_tracts <- st_join(lines, tracts)
```

```{r}
names(lines_tracts)
```

```{r}
tract_summary <- lines_tracts %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(
    total_trips = sum(TripCount, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_income = first(estimate)
  )
```


```{r}
tracts_map <- tracts %>%
  left_join(
    st_drop_geometry(tract_summary),
    by = "GEOID"
  )

metro_tracts <- tracts_map %>%
  filter(grepl("Hennepin|Ramsey|Dakota|Anoka|Washington|Scott|Carver", NAME))
```

```{r}
ggplot(metro_tracts) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = log1p(total_trips)), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "log(trips+1)") +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Transit trip density by census tract")

# Side-by-side income vs transit
library(patchwork)
p1 <- ggplot(metro_tracts) + geom_sf(aes(fill = median_income), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::dollar) + theme_void()
p2 <- ggplot(metro_tracts) + geom_sf(aes(fill = log1p(total_trips)), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") + theme_void()
p1 + p2
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

common_theme <- theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p1 <- ggplot(metro_tracts) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = median_income), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::dollar, name = "Median Income") +
  labs(title = "Median Household Income") +
  common_theme

p2 <- ggplot(metro_tracts) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = log1p(total_trips)), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Transit Trips (log)") +
  labs(title = "Transit Usage") +
  common_theme

p1 + p2 +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Income vs Transit Usage Across Census Tracts",
    subtitle = "Exploring spatial inequality and transportation patterns"
  )
```
